metric_definition: 2*mean(lambda-g+g*log(g/lambda))/mean(g), all 96x128x128 photopeak observations; lambda=Ha+independent scatter; zero-observation log term is zero.
tolerance_provenance: Predeclared normalized mean-deviance excess 1e-6 over independently evaluated attainable original field; not measured noise or unique activity accuracy.
scientific_accuracy_scope: measurement-consistent conditional reconstruction, no unique spatial truth certification
reference_role: Attainable conditional activity fit, no independent activity truth.
zero_prediction_policy: When observed count is positive and predicted count is zero, use log(float64 tiny) as a finite rejecting divergence report and return quality fail/1. This is reporting arithmetic, not physical count/noise flooring.
